reviews.comment:
Una vergüenza " NO TENEMOS AIRE, SE ROMPUO EL PICO" respuesta reiterada en todas las estaciones de servicio.  Una moda destestable eso lo escribí hace 3 años hoy volví a Umahuaca y pedí pasar al baño SOLO PARA CLIENTES  una vergüenza al cubo , fui a la Co.isaria a menos de 50 metros y la Cabo Primero me permitió amablemente pasar , el aca OBVIAMENTE no es ni la sombra de lo que fue en vida del Dr. Carman

(Translated by Google)
A disgrace: "WE HAVE NO AIR, THE NOZZLE IS BROKEN," a repeated response at every gas station. A detestable trend. I wrote about this three years ago. Today I returned to Umahuaca and asked to use the restroom, which is for customers only. A complete disgrace. I went to the police station less than 50 meters away, and the First Corporal kindly allowed me to go in. The place is obviously not even a shadow of what it was when Dr. Carman was alive.
